highlights.headline: Brown-Forman: Andrew Buskill sent the updated RTD inventory forecast Mon Nov 9 - 24k cases, about $300k, in Louisville, KY
Strength of Nature intro is TODAY, Mon Nov 9, 11:30 AM to 12:00 PM ET, with Mohammed Vali and Josh Smith attending
Subway: Dean Harrison met media lead Val on Wed Nov 4 as promised in his Nov 2 reply, but no follow-up has arrived through Mon Nov 9
Hain Celestial reports Q1 FY27 this morning (Mon Nov 9, before the open); public sources show no lender, Aurelius or restructuring resolution, and roughly $558M still matures Dec 22, 2026
Jonathan Halvorson moved from Kenvue Chief Digital and Marketing Officer to Kimberly-Clark Chief Marketing Officer, effective Nov 2, 2026 on the Kenvue acquisition close (Adweek, Nov 2)

lululemon appointed Ben Hallam (Four Seasons SVP Marketing) as Chief Brand Officer effective Nov 9 and Emily Sunderland (BCG) as Chief Strategy Officer effective Nov 23 (Business Wire, Nov 6); Nikki Neuburger and Ted Dagnese departed Nov 6 as scheduled

Lifetime Brands Q3 (Nov 5): $3.3M SKU rationalization reserve to mark down and exit slow-moving inventory ($2.0M US, $1.3M International), Hagerstown DC relocation disruption, UK facility exit planned, full year profit guidance cut to $19 to $20.5M

Stanley Black & Decker Q3 printed Nov 4 and confirmed the priority signal: $19.7M asset impairment (Excel Industries / Hustler plus the Q1 Tools and Outdoor line exit) and $29.5M restructuring, plants closed in Q2 and Q3, Excel sale expected to close around year end
Helen of Troy board unanimously rejected Empower Brands' public $37 per share bid (roughly $1.6B enterprise value) on Nov 4; the bidder's case cites $886M of FY2026 impairment charges

Kontoor Q3 printed Nov 5 (continuing revenue $685M, up 3 percent; adjusted EPS $1.50) and the Lee sale to Authentic Brands closed Nov 2 for $698M net; inventory $570M, down 6 percent, with roughly $50M of added inventory investment planned
